title: Albiflorin attenuates high glucose-induced endothelial apoptosis via suppressing PARP1/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
journal: Inflammation research : official journal of the European Histamine Research Society ... [et al.]
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芍药苷抑制高糖诱导的内皮细胞凋亡，涉及PARP1/NF-kappaB信号通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Paeonia lactiflora Pall has long been recognized as an anti-inflammatory traditional Chinese herbal medicine. We aimed to study the pharmacological action of albiflorin, an active ingredient extracted from the roots of Paeonia lactiflora Pall, on diabetic vascular complications. METHODS: Human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs) were stimulated with high glucose and treated with 5, 10, and 20 muM albiflorin. CCK-8 assay, EdU staining, Annexin V-FITC staining, transwell assay, scratch test, RT-PCR, ELISA, Western blot, and immunofluorescence were carried out. SwissTargetPrediction database was used for screening targets of albiflorin and molecular docking was done using Autodock Vina software. RESULTS: Albiflorin treatment dose-dependently alleviated high glucose-induced viability loss of HUVECs. In addition, albiflorin promoted the proliferation and migration, while inhibited apoptosis and the release of TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta in HUVECs. PARP1 was predicted and confirmed to be a target for albiflorin in vitro. Albiflorin targeted PARP1 to inhibit the activation of NF-kappaB. Transfection of HUVECs with PARP1 overexpression plasmids effectively reversed the effects of albiflorin on high glucose-treated HUVECs. CONCLUSIONS: Albiflorin suppressed high glucose-induced endothelial cell apoptosis and inflammation, suggesting its potential in treating diabetic vascular complications. The action of albiflorin possibly caused by its regulation on inhibiting PARP1/NF-kappaB signaling.
abstract_zh: 目的：白芍（Paeonia lactiflora Pall）长期被视为一种抗炎传统中草药。我们旨在研究从白芍根部提取的活性成分芍药苷（albiflorin）对糖尿病血管并发症的药理作用。方法：用人脐静脉内皮细胞（HUVECs）在高糖刺激下，并用5、10和20 μM芍药苷处理。进行了CCK-8实验、EdU染色、Annexin V-FITC染色、transwell实验、划痕实验、RT-PCR、ELISA、Western blot和免疫荧光检测。使用SwissTargetPrediction数据库筛选芍药苷的靶点，并使用Autodock Vina软件进行分子对接。结果：芍药苷处理剂量依赖性地缓解了高糖诱导的HUVECs活力丧失。此外，芍药苷促进了HUVECs的增殖和迁移，同时抑制了凋亡以及TNF-α、IL-6和IL-1β的释放。PARP1被预测并确认为芍药苷在体外的靶点。芍药苷靶向PARP1以抑制NF-κB的激活。用PARP1过表达质粒转染HUVECs有效逆转了芍药苷对高糖处理的HUVECs的作用。结论：芍药苷抑制了高糖诱导的内皮细胞凋亡和炎症，表明其在治疗糖尿病血管并发症方面具有潜力。芍药苷的作用可能通过其对抑制PARP1/NF-κB信号通路的调节来实现。
